title: What’s next for rStream’s AI recycling tech after Gillette Stadium debut
summary: The robotics company plans to double down on its niche sorting market with its recent $1.25 million DOE grant. Airports and “lower resource” locations may be next, co-founder Ethan Walko told Waste Dive.

title: Latest recycling facility upgrades target safety, limited disposal capacity
summary: Amp will help divert recyclables from MSW in Michigan, Prince George’s County officials in Maryland celebrated key upgrades to their MRF’s fiber lines and baling improvements at a Virginia recycling center add efficiency.

title: Clean Harbors buying EnviroServe from private equity for $470M
summary: The company is continuing its spree of deals for diversified environmental services companies. EnviroServe is expected to generate $250 million in adjusted annual revenue.

title: Amy Lestition Burke departs role as SWANA leader
summary: The long-standing industry group confirmed the leadership change was effective Monday. It plans to have a permanent replacement by the end of the year. Burke departs after less than three years at the helm.

title: Total M&A spending in 2026 surpasses $2.7B among top waste companies
summary: A busy second quarter in which approximately $2 billion worth of transactions closed contributed to a torrid deal pace. Executives discussed additional spending plans as the year continues.

title: Win Waste opts to close New York incinerator amid market challenges
summary: The company said the decision came after an operational review and the U.S. EPA’s update of applicable air regulations. It disputed the impact of a strict local law passed to further limit emissions.

title: Casella Q2 benefits from landfill volumes, acquisition rollover
summary: Third-party landfill tons gave the company a boost in the capacity-constrained Northeast, and it’s steadily working to integrate its mid-Atlantic assets. But high fuel costs and lower collection volumes were headwinds in Q2.

title: Republic Services boosts guidance amid improving commodities
summary: The company is seeing positive signs in several underlying dynamics, including commercial construction activity. Other growth intiatives, including polymer centers and PFAS-related business, are also netting returns.

title: What’s next as Hawai’i enacts clean fuels program; Biogas news from Waga, Convertus
summary: The state’s governor signed a law that creates a clean fuel standard by 2028. Other biogas news include a Waga Energy and Casella Waste Systems project, a Redtail Renewables deal and Convertus project financing.
